name: AR_TRX_BAL_SUMMARY
description: This table stores the fields that summarize data over time, such as, Open Balance, Open Invoices Count, and Open Invoices Value.  This table stores the business unit identifier to ensure that data can be retrieved by bill to customer account site. The lowest level of granularity at which the data is stored and retrieved from this table is for a given currency at a specified customer bill to location for a given customer account of a party.

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Customer Account Identifier

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Site Use Identifier

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency code

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BEST_CURRENT_RECEIVABLES
columns.description: Amount due remaining on open payment schedules (installments) of all transactions, such as, Invoices, Debit Memos, Bills Receivables, Chargebacks and Deposits, that have a due date greater than or equal to the system date for the specific account, site and currency.

columns.name: TOTAL_DSO_DAYS_CREDIT
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: OP_INVOICES_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of amount_due_remaining on open payment schedules (installments) of all the Invoices the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_INVOICES_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Invoices for the specific Account, Site and Currency

columns.name: OP_DEBIT_MEMOS_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Debit Memos for the specific Account, Site and Currency

columns.name: OP_DEBIT_MEMOS_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of amount_due_remaining on open payment schedules (installments)  of all the Debit Memos for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_DEPOSITS_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of amount_due_remaining on open payment schedules (installments)  of all the Deposits for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_DEPOSITS_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Deposits for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_BILLS_RECEIVABLES_VALUE
columns.description: Remaining open balance on all bills receivable in a particular currency that belong to one customer site.

columns.name: OP_BILLS_RECEIVABLES_COUNT
columns.description: Number of bills receivable with an open balance in a particular currency that belong to one customer site.

columns.name: OP_CHARGEBACK_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of amount_due_remaining on open payment schedules (installments)  of all the Chargebacks for the specific Account, Site and Currency

columns.name: OP_CHARGEBACK_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Chargebacks for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_CREDIT_MEMOS_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of amount_due_remaining on open payment schedules (installments)  of all the Credit Memos for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: OP_CREDIT_MEMOS_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Credit Memos for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: UNRESOLVED_CASH_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of unresolved cash available on all the Cash Receipts for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: UNRESOLVED_CASH_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains count of all the Cash Receipts for the specific Account, Site and Currency that have unresolved cash on them.

columns.name: RECEIPTS_AT_RISK_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of  cash receipt amounts for the specific Account, Site and Currency that have a status of 'At Risk'.

columns.name: INV_AMT_IN_DISPUTE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of the amount in dispute on open payment schedules (installments) of all the invoices for the specific Account, Site and Currency.

columns.name: DISPUTED_INV_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains the count of open payment schedules (installments)  of all Invoices for the specific Account, Site and Currency that have a dispute amount.

columns.name: PENDING_ADJ_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of the adjustment amounts on all debit items for the specific Account, Site and Currency that have not been approved, i.e., the adjustment status is not 'Approved' or 'Rejected'.

columns.name: LAST_DUNNING_DATE
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: DUNNING_COUNT
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: PAST_DUE_INV_VALUE
columns.description: This column value contains the sum of the amount_due_remaining of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Invoices for the specific Account, Site and Currency, that are past their due date.

columns.name: PAST_DUE_INV_INST_COUNT
columns.description: This column value contains a count of the open payments schedules (installments) of all the Invoices for the specific Account, Site and Currency, that are past their due date.

columns.name: LAST_PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the most recent cash receipt (based on receipt date) for the specific Account, Site, Currency and a date (identified by as_of_date column).

columns.name: LAST_PAYMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of the most recent cash receipt (based on receipt date) for the specific Account, Site, Currency.

columns.name: LAST_PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: cash_receipt_id of the most recent cash receipt (based on receipt date) for the specific Account, Site, Currency.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
